primary_sources.title: Hillman--Sakuma, On the homology of finite abelian coverings of links, Canadian Mathematical Bulletin40(1997),309-315
primary_sources.used_statement: For knots the cyclic exterior homology splits integrally as the branched-cover homology plus Z; the page also warns that equal Alexander polynomials do not determine homology-group structure in general. PF65 reproves the integral split with explicit peripheral maps and computes the full torus Alexander module, not only its order.

primary_sources.title: Clay--Watson, On cabled knots, Dehn surgery, and left-orderable fundamental groups (2011v1)
primary_sources.used_statement: Complete PDF6: Section2 annular root-amalgam presentation and explicit cable meridian/longitude with positive Bezout pair. Specialize winding r, parameter k=rc+1 and choose v_C=r-1,u_C=c(r-1)+1. The proof note converts to beta*z and conjugates to z*beta while fixing M,L,h. No orderability or surgery theorem imported.

primary_sources.title: Neumann--Raymond, Seifert manifolds, plumbing, mu-invariant and orientation reversing maps, LNM664(1978),163-196
primary_sources.used_statement: Theorem1.2 Euler naturality for oriented fibre-preserving maps, including branched maps; signed inverse slice convention and Euler definition; Theorem5.1 star plumbing and signed continued fractions, intersection form, and Theorem5.2 Schur/definiteness convention. Convert the paper signed leg parameter to minus the positive beta in a normalized negative leg. The proof derives the model, Euler number, selected inverse entry and mod3 mismatch; no contact/filling classification or full satellite plumbing theorem imported.

primary_sources.title: Stacks Lemma54.4.3
primary_sources.used_statement: Resolve a rational map from a regular surface to a proper scheme by point blowups outside its existing domain; apply outside N.

primary_sources.title: Stacks Lemma54.17.1
primary_sources.used_statement: A proper birational morphism between regular surfaces factors as point blowups. Retained leaves and volume-order induction are proved in the new note, not imported from this lemma.

primary_sources.title: Zannier, On Davenport bound for f^3-g^2 and Riemann Existence Theorem, Acta Arithmetica71(1995),107-137
primary_sources.used_statement: Complete PDF7-8/printed113-114: equation(3) root partitions, lower bound(4), equality implies coprimality and squarefree difference, general bound(6), and Theorem1 attainment for all prescribed multiplicities. Import the existence theorem only; no independent proof of its full inductive construction or rational-coefficient realization is claimed. Uniform coprime partitions yield the unbounded polynomial immersion specialization in the note.

primary_sources.title: Neumann--Norbury, The Orevkov invariant of an affine plane curve
primary_sources.used_statement: Retain complete PDF6-7 and12-13 audits of infinity cabling and canonical recurrence. In the actual-binomial trefoil class eta=k-w-1.

primary_sources.title: Livingston-Melvin, Abelian invariants of satellite knots
primary_sources.used_statement: Retain complete PDF6-7 Theorem2/Seifert-corollary audit of the satellite Alexander formula, specializing exactly at -1.

retained_imports: PF63 cable words; PF65 integral cyclic companion splitting and Alexander module; PF66 oriented linking; PF67 source factorization. Prior visual/source audits retained, no new independent source review.
